tools.name: discover_pages
tools.description: List the pages of Site A (sitemap, robots.txt, or crawl), mapped onto Site B when given. Paid in USDC (the 402 challenge names the network): 0.05 USD per call.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.description: Full-page PNG of one URL. Returns the image (or, for a large one, links.file to fetch with the jobToken) plus a jobId/jobToken for get_screenshot. Paid in USDC (the 402 challenge names the network): 0.02 USD per call.

tools.name: start_comparison
tools.description: Compare Site A against Site B on page existence, content and visual regression. Charged upfront in USDC (the 402 challenge names the network): 0.02 USD per page for the first 1000 pages and 0.01 USD per page beyond. maxPages is optional: a ceiling, not a reservation. A job is priced on the pages it

tools.name: recover_comparison
tools.description: Returns the job or screenshot the payment credential in _meta paid for, with a new jobToken that replaces the old one. For a paid call whose result never arrived. Free.

tools.name: get_comparison
tools.description: Status and progress of a job. Free.

tools.name: cancel_comparison
tools.description: Stop a running job; the job reports cancelled within a minute, with the pages compared so far in its report. Free.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: The finished report: summary over every page, a slice of the per-page results (offset and limit, default 50 a call, at most 5000; nextOffset points at the next slice), and the plain-text report over that slice. limit: 1 returns the summary with one result. Free.

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.description: A screenshot PNG named in the report or returned by capture_screenshot; a large one comes back as links.file to fetch with the jobToken. Free.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "start_comparison" is 1092 chars, far longer than this server's median (164). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
